clauses.scope_note: Aliyun Bailian Service Agreement, section 11.3; duties of the party affected by force majeure or an accidental event that impedes performance.
clauses.condition_explanation: The trigger is an event covered by section 11.1–11.2 that affects performance. The affected party must mitigate, resume affected duties as soon as possible where feasible, notify the other party immediately, and provide necessary and reasonable proof within 15 days after the event, explaining the reason for nonperformance or delay.

obligation_items.content: Take appropriate measures to reduce or eliminate the effects of the force-majeure or accidental event, and resume affected obligations as soon as possible to the extent possible.
obligation_items.object: Performance of that party's affected agreement obligations
obligation_items.trigger: When a force-majeure or accidental event affects performance.

obligation_items.content: Immediately notify the other party of the force-majeure or accidental event.
obligation_items.object: Notice of the event affecting performance
obligation_items.trigger: When a force-majeure or accidental event affects performance.

obligation_items.content: Provide the other party necessary and reasonable supporting documents and explain the reasons for nonperformance or delayed performance.
obligation_items.object: Supporting documents and explanation concerning the affected obligations
obligation_items.trigger: Within 15 days after the force-majeure or accidental event.

clauses.scope_note: Aliyun Bailian Service Agreement, section 11.4; termination option after prolonged force majeure and unsuccessful consultation.
clauses.condition_explanation: The event must prevent performance of all or part of the agreement for at least 60 days. The parties then consult about conditions for continuation or termination; if they cannot agree on continuation conditions within 30 days after consultation starts, either may terminate immediately by notice.

clauses.scope_note: Aliyun Bailian Service Agreement, section 13.2; applies to products or services supplied by the provider and to direct or indirect provision or use.
clauses.condition_explanation: The licensee promises compliance with applicable PRC export-control and economic-sanctions laws and other applicable export-control and sanctions laws. The prohibition concerns direct or indirect provision to a country or region listed under applicable laws or to a person or entity on a restricted list, and direct or indirect use for a purpose prohibited by those laws.

obligation_items.content: Do not directly or indirectly provide the provider's products or services to a country or region listed under applicable export-control or economic-sanctions laws, or to a person or entity on an applicable restricted list.
obligation_items.trigger: At all times, subject to applicable export-control and economic-sanctions laws.

obligation_items.content: Do not directly or indirectly use the provider's products or services for a purpose prohibited by applicable export-control or economic-sanctions laws.
obligation_items.trigger: At all times, subject to applicable export-control and economic-sanctions laws.

clauses.scope_note: Aliyun Bailian Service Agreement, section 13.3; continued use after an amendment takes effect is treated as acceptance of the amendment.
clauses.condition_explanation: Changes may take effect upon notice or publication, or on the specified effective date, subject to mandatory legal or regulatory requirements. The clause states that continued service use constitutes acceptance; it does not require continued use.

clauses.scope_note: Aliyun Bailian Service Agreement, section 13.4; provider-side transfer right, not a licensee transfer permission.
clauses.condition_explanation: The provider may transfer all or part of its rights and obligations under the agreement to an affiliate after advance notice.

coverage_notes: The target is Aliyun Bailian Service Agreement sections 7.2–13.8. No local incorporated documents were supplied; section 7.3 refers ownership allocation for fine-tuned models to service documentation, website announcements, or third-party license terms, whose contents are not stated here.

Sections 7.4, 8.5, and 9.5 allocate responsibility or compensation for claims, losses, or damages. Those payment/indemnity actions do not fit an allowed activity faithfully and are outside activity scope; they are not converted into Charge or SellCopies rules.

Section 13.4 authorizes provider transfer of agreement rights and obligations; transfer is not an available activity, so the clause records the authorization but cannot represent it as an allowed activity rule.
The separately extracted confidentiality exceptions and duties, IP provisions, contact-information duties, and 72-hour termination option are assessed against the immutable anchors below.

paragraph_audit.reason: The anchors and added clauses cover expressible operative rules in the target. The paragraph remains unresolved because the agreement contains operative compensation/indemnity allocations in sections 7.4, 8.5, and 9.5, and a provider transfer authorization in section 13.4, that cannot be faithfully represented with the allowed activities; section 7.3 also leaves fine-tuned-model ownership to external terms not supplied.
